prompt: Mina writes: 'If I feel distracted, then I will try harder to focus.' After two weeks it has not helped. What is the main flaw in this implementation intention?

options.text: It has too many steps to remember under pressure
The cue and the response are both vague, so in the moment she cannot tell exactly when to act or what to do
Implementation intentions only work if they are written by someone else
She should have planned for a whole hour instead of a moment

explanation: An if-then plan works when the cue is specific and observable and the response is a concrete action, such as 'If I reach for my phone, then I will put it in the hallway and restart a 10-minute timer.'
